text: Universe polymorphism in dependent type theory is needed because:
choices: types cannot be elements of other types
without it, 'the type of all types' would be in itself, leading to Girard's paradox
explanation: 'Type : Type' (Russell's paradox analogue) is inconsistent (Girard's paradox). A hierarchy U₀:U₁:U₂:… (universe polymorphism) avoids this while allowing types to be elements.
